bio: All-day restaurants are sometimes overlooked, but don't count out East Nashville's Cafe Roze; it's more than meets the eye. Whether you come for coffee or breakfast, swing by for an afternoon glass of wine or stop by on your way home for dinner, this welcoming spot hits all the right notes. The menu leans lighter with vegetable-forward small plates and oysters that seem simple but have unexpected depth. Grilled long beans atop hummus with green nasturtium zhoug is deeply savory and watermelon radish tossed in an urfu vinaigrette with greens is refreshing, while pork schnitzel with brown butter-chili sauce and a zesty slaw offers a fresh take on a classic. For dessert, you'll never go wrong with the creamy chocolate mousse....
